description: A small wooden Jenga tower sits on a bed with a purple sheet next to a pink pillow. The left hand comes in from the left and the right hand comes in from the right to cup the tower as a two-hand object, gently squeezing and nudging it to square up the stacked blocks, then the right hand relaxes and lifts away while the left hand loosens and pulls back, leaving the tower standing centered on the bed.
